conclusion: Served POINT values are already fully true-to-model on both surfaces (translation exp is never clamped; projection WAR is unfloored - 604 median negatives served live; the WAR map is raw OLS with no clamp). Of the whole clamp inventory, exactly ONE is genuine display compression: the translation _band() upper soft-caps on the rate lines, which cap the displayed P10-P90 upper whisker BELOW the model's own LOO-validated band (college pit_bb=25 binds 23 rows, producing hi==exp artifacts). SHIP: raise the rate hi_clips to the true [0,100] domain (coverage-invariant, exp-invariant, monotone). Every other clamp is numerical/domain safety (rate>=0, pt>=0, FIP>=1.0 [inert], season_fraction, curve support, quantile monotone sort), an accuracy-load-bearing RTM/recenter (slope shrink, mean/star lift-only blend - validated), or true-to-model by design (NO ZERO FLOOR).
